title: UltraExtraction
description: Teleport players after staying in the area for a set time
body:
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bbbd9e496d875de3923eabdb18e86de56866a00.png)

[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/869498fbda9b0904fe8d122fae2a26d599c763bc.png)](https://discord.com/invite/qCZwhjM9Tu)
<details>
<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>
  
A plugin that allows you to create zones where players must stay for a set amount of time to be teleported to a destination. You can customize all types of messages and sounds.

Compatible with PvPManager to determine whether or not you can extract while in combat.

```
COMMANDS:
/ultraextraction wand
/ultraextraction create <name>
/ultraextraction setdestination <name>
/ultraextraction reload

PLACEHOLDERS:
%ultraextraction_zone%: Current zone the player is in.
%ultraextraction_remaining%: Time left for extraction (seconds).
%ultraextraction_remaining_formatted%: Time left in MM:SS format.
%ultraextraction_cooldown%: Remaining cooldown time.
```



💡 Why UltraExtraction?
Unlike other heavy plugins, UltraExtraction is optimized to have zero impact on server performance. Its modular design allows you to create simple extraction points or complex escape-based game modes in minutes.

</details>
